answer: By coupling recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function, each system thread is bound to a sequential computation that cannot be parallelized. To enforce a robust Nash equilibrium, agents must lock staking collateral subject to severe slashing penalties upon proof of equivocation, yielding a negative expected utility for any cloning attempt. When distributed across nodes from a high mesa to a frozen tundra, validators cryptographically verify these proofs, guaranteeing finality and complete Sybil resistance.
